correctness.rationale: The sixteen vertices are F_2^4 with adjacency differences {1,2,4,8,15}; enumerating all independent sets gives f=(16,80,160,120,16). Independently regenerated 191 Morse pairs, one critical vertex and nine critical 3-cells, and topologically sorted all 392 faces across 1200 Hasse incidences. Independently calculated signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz trace of all 1920 elements of N⋊S_5 and matched sgn(p)(#Fix(p)-1+sum_{p(i)=i} lambda_i(t)). Because rational representations of finite groups are semisimple and the proposed rational summands have exactly these characters, the graded module is sgn⊗(P0⊕M), with H3 dimension 9 and all other reduced homology zero. The bound 16·5!=1920 follows from vertex image and five-neighbor permutations; N⋊S5 attains it. The character restriction yields 4 trivial translation copies and five weight-four characters.
